S001.zh: 这个整合包来自 CurseForge，需要 API key 才能自动下载 mod。key 免费申请：curseforge.com/account/api-keys，填一次会保存在 minecraft\curseforge-key.txt。
S001.en: This modpack comes from CurseForge and needs an API key to download mods automatically. Free key: curseforge.com/account/api-keys. Saved once to minecraft\curseforge-key.txt.

S005.zh: 这一步会把实例目录整个删掉，存档和 mods 都不进回收站，删完不能恢复。
S005.en: This deletes the whole instance folder. Saves and mods do not go to the Recycle Bin and cannot be recovered.

S006.zh: 确认请把实例名原样敲一遍：
S006.en: Type the instance name to confirm:

S007.zh: 必须和实例名一致，删除按钮才会亮
S007.en: Must match the instance name to enable the delete button

S010.zh: 详细信息（复制给开发者）

S021.zh: 登录成功后 token 会存进 minecraft\accounts.json（明文，仅本机）。
S021.en: After a successful login the token is stored in minecraft\accounts.json (plain text, local only).

S022.zh: 首页选实例，底部启动；版本/实例/资源/账号分页管理。
S022.en: Pick an instance on Home and launch from the bottom bar; manage versions, instances, resources and accounts on their pages.

S023.zh: 选一个实例，然后点底部「启动游戏」
S023.en: Pick an instance, then click Launch at the bottom

S028.zh: 先选 Minecraft 版本，再决定原版/Fabric/Forge/NeoForge
S028.en: Pick a Minecraft version first, then vanilla/Fabric/Forge/NeoForge

S029.zh: 输入 1.20 / 26.2 / fabric 过滤右边列表
S029.en: Type 1.20 / 26.2 / fabric to filter the list

S030.zh: 版本列表；左边输入框可以过滤
S030.en: Version list; use the box on the left to filter

S032.zh: 加载器版本；Fabric 启动时自动安装，Forge/NeoForge 先点「安装」
S032.en: Loader version; Fabric installs at launch, Forge/NeoForge need Install first

S034.zh: Forge/NeoForge 专用：先安装，再把版本切到生成的条目；Fabric 在启动时自动安装
S034.en: Forge/NeoForge only: install first, then switch to the generated entry; Fabric installs at launch

S037.zh: Fabric 选版本即可，启动时自动合并；Forge/NeoForge 选版本后点「安装」，安装完版本会自动切到生成的条目。安装器运行中可以取消，已生成的部分文件会保留，下次安装会复用。启动按钮在底部。
S037.en: For Fabric just pick a version and it merges at launch. For Forge/NeoForge pick a version and click Install; the version switches to the generated entry afterwards. The installer can be cancelled; files already produced are kept and reused next time. Launch is at the bottom.

S038.zh: 每个实例有自己的存档、mods、设置
S038.en: Each instance has its own saves, mods and settings

S039.en: Leave blank to use the version name

S042.en: Renames the record and the folder together

S044.zh: 复制成新实例；默认不带存档，避免两边都以为在用同一份世界
S044.en: Copy to a new instance; saves are excluded so both sides don't think they share one world

S046.zh: 会先问：只删记录，还是连文件一起删
S046.en: Asks first: remove the record only, or delete files too

S050.zh: 只有用「导入」创建的整合包实例才能更新
S050.en: Only instances created by Import can be updated

S053.zh: http(s)://…/pack.json，或本地目录 / zip 解出来的托管目录
S053.en: http(s)://…/pack.json, or a local folder / unzipped hosted folder

S055.zh: 把当前实例的 mods / config 导出成可托管的目录（含 pack.json 清单）
S055.en: Export this instance's mods / config as a hostable folder (with pack.json)

S057.zh: 只下载有差异的文件，删掉服主已移除的文件
S057.en: Download only changed files and remove files the owner deleted

S059.zh: 恢复到上一次同步前的状态
S059.en: Restore the state before the last sync

S063.zh: 带上 --server / --port 启动，直接连进服务器

S065.zh: 导出：生成可上传的目录；同步：按 pack.json 只传差异并保留快照；进服：同步后直接连服务器。
S065.en: Export: produce a hostable folder; Sync: transfer only diffs per pack.json and keep snapshots; Join: sync then connect to the server.

S066.zh: Modrinth 搜索安装 + 当前实例的本地 mods（jar 可以直接拖到这一页）
S066.en: Install from Modrinth search + local mods of the current instance (drag jars onto this page)

S069.zh: 例如 sodium、iris、fabric api；回车搜索
S069.en: e.g. sodium, iris, fabric api; press Enter to search

S073.zh: 按名字 / 文件名 / mod id 过滤
S073.en: Filter by name / file name / mod id

S082.zh: 离线 / 外置（Yggdrasil）/ 微软正版

S087.zh: 选一张 64×64 或 64×32 的 PNG，只用于启动器里预览头像
S087.en: Pick a 64×64 or 64×32 PNG; used only for the avatar preview in the launcher

S088.zh: 正版登录使用微软 device code；外置登录使用 LittleSkin 等 Yggdrasil 站点。
S088.en: Microsoft login uses the device code flow; external login uses Yggdrasil sites such as LittleSkin.

S089.zh: 内存 / Java / 下载源 / 启动器更新
S089.en: Memory / Java / download source / launcher updates

S090.zh: 把当前全部数据复制到新目录，并切换启动器数据位置；旧目录保留
S090.en: Copy all data to a new folder and switch the launcher there; the old folder is kept

S091.zh: 手机和电脑同一局域网时，用手机浏览器遥控启动
S091.en: Control the launcher from your phone browser when both are on the same LAN

S092.zh: 把旧版 minecraft 或 %APPDATA%\Lx 的数据复制到当前数据目录；不覆盖已有文件
S092.en: Copy data from an old minecraft folder or %APPDATA%\Lx into the current data folder; existing files are not overwritten

S093.zh: 从 CurseForge 开发者控制台申请
S093.en: Get one from the CurseForge developer console

S095.zh: Key 用 DPAPI 加密保存在数据目录；不填 Key 时只能用 Modrinth。
S095.en: The key is stored DPAPI-encrypted in the data folder; without it only Modrinth is available.

S096.zh: 自更新的「检查更新」在设置窗口里；发布版才会真正替换文件。
S096.en: Self-update's Check for updates lives in the settings window; only released builds really replace files.

S097.zh: 启动器日志；底部可复制失败清单/打开日志目录/校验文件
S097.en: Launcher log; copy failures / open logs folder / verify files at the bottom

S098.zh: 按 sha1 重新检查并补齐当前版本/实例的文件
S098.en: Re-check and fill in files of the current version/instance by sha1

S103.zh: 提示：没有 Azure client id 时会报 AADSTS700038；注册应用后把「应用程序(客户端) ID」填到上面。
S103.en: Tip: without an Azure client id you will see AADSTS700038; after registering an app, paste its Application (client) ID above.

S105.zh: 手机和电脑连同一个局域网，用手机浏览器打开下面的地址。地址里已经带配对 token。
S105.en: Phone and PC on the same LAN: open the address below in the phone browser. The address already contains the pairing token.

S113.zh: 只在局域网使用。Windows 防火墙弹窗时选择“允许访问”；不要把这个地址转发到公网。
S113.en: LAN only. Allow access when Windows Firewall asks; never forward this address to the internet.

S114.zh: 选择要使用的角色（会重新签发该角色的 token）：
S114.en: Choose a role (a new token will be issued for it):

S124.zh: 例如 -XX:+UseG1GC -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8；留空则只用版本默认值
S124.en: e.g. -XX:+UseG1GC -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8; blank uses the version defaults

S125.zh: 空格分隔；带空格的参数用双引号包起来。
S125.en: Space separated; quote arguments that contain spaces.

S133.zh: 兼容 BMCLAPI 路径的镜像根地址，例如 https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com
S133.en: Mirror root compatible with BMCLAPI paths, e.g. https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com

S138.zh: 代理只作用于启动器下载（游戏本体/库/assets）；系统模式使用 Windows 设置。
S138.en: Proxy affects launcher downloads only (game/libs/assets); System mode follows Windows settings.

S142.zh: 界面文案已全部走 i18n；日志和少数提示仍是中文。
S142.en: All UI text goes through i18n now; log messages and a few hints stay Chinese.

S144.zh: 发布版把对应通道的 update.json 放到数据目录，或在 LX_UPDATE_URL 指定。
S144.en: Release builds put the matching update.json in the data folder, or point LX_UPDATE_URL at it.

S146.zh: 崩溃时上传诊断报告（默认关闭）

S147.zh: 勾选后才会发送；报告内容见下方说明
S147.en: Sent only when checked; see the notes below for what is included

S148.zh: 包含：启动器/Windows/.NET 版本、异常类型与堆栈、最近约 80 行日志（token 与密钥自动打码）。不包含账号密码、存档、mods。
S148.en: Includes: launcher/Windows/.NET versions, exception type and stack, last ~80 log lines (tokens and keys are redacted). Never includes passwords, saves or mods.

S150.zh: 留空则只保存在本地 logs\crash\；也可以由环境变量 LX_CRASH_ENDPOINT 覆盖
S150.en: Leave blank to keep reports local in logs\crash\; the LX_CRASH_ENDPOINT env var can override it

S152.zh: 不填地址时，崩溃报告只写到 logs\crash\，不会联网。
S152.en: With no URL, crash reports are written to logs\crash\ only and never sent.

S158.zh: 深色主题只覆盖窗口/面板/主要文本，复杂控件模板后续再细化。
S158.en: Dark theme currently covers windows/panels/main text only; complex control templates are refined later.

S161.zh: 自更新：设置窗口底部「检查更新」。更新包会校验 sha256，失败自动回滚。
S161.en: Self-update: Check for updates at the bottom of the settings window. Packages are sha256-verified and roll back on mismatch.

S163.zh: 检查 update.json 里是否有新版本
S163.en: Check update.json for a newer version

S185.zh: 快捷键：Ctrl+1~7 切换页面，F5 校验/修复，Ctrl+Enter 启动，Esc 取消
S185.en: Shortcuts: Ctrl+1~7 switch pages, F5 verify/repair, Ctrl+Enter launch, Esc cancel

S186.zh: 自动（按版本选择，缺失时自动下载）
S186.en: Auto (pick by version, download if missing)

S189.zh: 自定义（兼容 BMCLAPI 路径）

S200.zh: CurseForge 需要 API Key：先在「设置」页保存
S200.en: CurseForge needs an API key: save one on the Settings page first

S206.zh: 更新包已保留，可稍后再装
S206.en: Update package kept; you can install it later

S209.zh: 旧数据迁移完成，重启后生效
S209.en: Old data migrated; restart to apply

S210.zh: 开发版不支持自更新；请用 publish.ps1 生成的发布版测试。
S210.en: Dev builds cannot self-update; test with a release built by publish.ps1.

S216.zh: 数据目录已迁移，重启后生效
S216.en: Data folder migrated; restart to apply

S222.zh: 未配置更新地址：设置环境变量 LX_UPDATE_URL，或把 update.json 放到数据目录。
S222.en: No update URL configured: set LX_UPDATE_URL or put update.json in the data folder.

S223.zh: 先输入搜索关键词，例如 sodium 或 iris
S223.en: Type a search term first, e.g. sodium or iris

S224.zh: 先在搜索结果里选一个 mod（需要先点「搜索」）
S224.en: Pick a mod from the search results first (click Search)

S232.zh: 正在导出…（要算一遍 sha1，大包会慢一会儿）
S232.en: Exporting… (computes sha1; large packs take a while)

S242.zh: 发现 {0} 个 mod 问题

S248.zh: 同步失败：{0} 个文件没下全；已保留同步前快照
S248.en: Sync failed: {0} files incomplete; pre-sync snapshot kept

S250.zh: 校验完成：仍有 {0} 个文件失败

S255.zh: 已回滚：恢复/删除 {0} 个文件，校验不一致 {1}

S256.zh: 已回滚到 {0}：恢复/删除 {1} 个文件，校验不一致 {2}
S256.en: Rolled back to {0}: restored/deleted {1} files, {2} mismatches

S258.zh: 已同步到 {0}：下载 {1}，删除 {2}，已是最新 {3}

S268.zh: 启动器还能继续操作，但状态可能已经不对，建议重启。
S268.en: The launcher can continue, but its state may be wrong; a restart is recommended.

S269.zh: 进程即将退出，请重新启动。
S269.en: The process is about to exit; please start it again.

S279.zh: 本地离线账号，不会过期

S283.zh: 还没有账号：先输入离线名点「添加」，或直接用「正版登录」。
S283.en: No accounts yet: type an offline name and click Add, or use Microsoft login.

S284.zh: Lx yulin carp 已经在运行。
S284.en: Lx yulin carp is already running.

S285.zh: 复制失败，请手动选中详情文本。
S285.en: Copy failed; select the details manually.

S287.zh: 手机遥控窗口已经打开。
S287.en: The remote control window is already open.

S288.zh: 当前启动器由 LX_DATA_DIR 环境变量指定数据目录，设置里的更改会被环境变量覆盖。\n\n请先移除 LX_DATA_DIR，再更改数据目录。
S288.en: The data folder is set by the LX_DATA_DIR environment variable, so changes here are overridden.\n\nRemove LX_DATA_DIR before changing the data folder.

S289.zh: 请手动关闭并重新打开启动器。
S289.en: Close and reopen the launcher manually.

S290.zh: 这个目录不像 Lx 数据目录。\n\n应包含 accounts.json、versions、libraries 或 assets。
S290.en: This does not look like an Lx data folder.\n\nIt should contain accounts.json, versions, libraries or assets.

S291.zh: 扫描了 {0} 个 mod，未发现重复 mod id 或缺失的 required 依赖。
S291.en: Scanned {0} mods; no duplicate mod ids or missing required dependencies.

S293.zh: 游戏还在运行。退出启动器不会关闭游戏，确定退出吗？
S293.en: The game is still running. Quitting the launcher will not close it. Quit anyway?

S294.zh: 更新包已下载并通过校验。现在重启启动器并安装吗？
S294.en: The update was downloaded and verified. Restart the launcher now to install it?

S312.zh: 迁移完成：{0} 个文件，{1:F1} MB。\n\n旧目录仍然保留。现在重启启动器以使用新目录吗？
S312.en: Migration done: {0} files, {1:F1} MB.\n\nThe old folder is kept. Restart the launcher to use the new folder?

S314.zh: 同步未完成：{0} 个文件下载失败。\n现在回滚到同步前吗？（也可以稍后点「回滚」）
S314.en: Sync incomplete: {0} files failed to download.\nRoll back to the pre-sync state now? (You can also click Rollback later.)

S315.zh: 恢复到 {0} 的同步前状态？\n同步之后手动改过的文件会被覆盖。
S315.en: Restore the pre-sync state of {0}?\nFiles edited since the last sync will be overwritten.

S316.zh:
删除实例「{0}」？

{1}

是：连文件一起删（存档、mods 都没了，不能恢复）
否：只删记录，文件保留在磁盘上
取消：什么都不做
S316.en:
Delete instance "{0}"?

{1}

Yes: delete files too (saves and mods are gone permanently)
No: remove the record only, files stay on disk
Cancel: do nothing

S317.zh: 发现 {0} 个更新：{1}\n\n旧 jar 会先备份到 mods/.lx-backup，然后下载并替换。现在更新吗？
S317.en: Found {0} updates:{1}\n\nOld jars are backed up to mods/.lx-backup before downloading. Update now?

S318.zh: 游戏异常退出（退出码 {0}），运行时长 {1}。\n\n是否打开日志目录？
S318.en: The game exited unexpectedly (code {0}) after {1}.\n\nOpen the logs folder?

S319.zh: 发现新版本 v{0}（当前 v{1}）。\n\n现在下载并更新吗？
S319.en: New version v{0} available (current v{1}).\n\nDownload and update now?
